name: video-enhancer
title: 视频增强器
description: Cloud-based video enhancement skill that uploads a user-selected local video file to Wondershare-hosted endpoints for AI enhancement, then downloads the processed result back to local storage. Use only when the user explicitly agrees to third-party cloud processing for a non-sensitive video, when user says "enhance video", "improve video quality", "upscale video", "make video clearer", "fix blurry video", "restore old footage", "video enhancement", "convert to HD", or provides a video file and requests quality improvement. supports MP4/MOV.
